A whole paradise to discover, just around the corner of Europe

Discover Morocco on an intense trip with us: the imperial cities and their medinas, the adobe kasbahs, the Berbers and the nomadic peoples, immense beaches and the mysterious Sahara Desert.

What we do

Routes

8 to 15-day circuits through the Atlas, the kasbahs and the desert, by 4x4 with our own guide.

Excursions

Day trips from Marrakech and from Fez: Ouzoud, Essaouira, Ouarzazate, Meknes, Ifrane.

Riad Madu

A small adobe kasbah with 12 rooms at the foot of the Erg Chebbi dunes.

Madu Luxury Camp

A camp of 10 tents with private bathrooms in the heart of the desert.

Quad & Buggy

Guided half-day or full-day tours across the dunes.

Get hooked on Morocco

If you embark on a trip with us, we will get to know a distinctive country together. There is frenzied activity in every corner. The picturesque and everyday life, the religious and the profane, the noise of the medinas of the big imperial cities and the vision of the infinite desert all mix together.

You will discover the easiest and freest way to experience the life of the mountain people, and you will learn why the nomadic tribes living in the desert believe that true wisdom is found there: only necessary things, nothing superficial. Discovering how nomadic and mountain people live is a lesson in humility. It proves that finding happiness can be much easier than people in the so-called developed countries, with all their superfluous and material things, can imagine.

One minute in the desert

The best value for money

If you contact us you will discover that our routes are neither the cheapest nor the most expensive, but we believe the price is fair for the quality of our services and the activities we offer that other agencies do not. Propose your route and your dates and we will organise the best trip.
